A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same loss-characterization and density-ratio estimation work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A–C support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original synthetic kernel experiments and domain-adaptation benchmark results in Figures 1–3, Table 1, and Appendix C.

after.justification: V2 retains the work's original synthetic experiments and benchmark results on AmazonReviews, HHAR, and MiniDomainNet, including the appendix tables.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1, the loss construction, canonical link, and exponential and polynomial loss families are retained. The exponential and polynomial examples exchange equation numbers and presentation order without changing the proposed procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same synthetic density-ratio and weighted-regression scenarios and the same AmazonReviews, HHAR, and MiniDomainNet tasks. The 484 parameter-selection problems are already present in v1.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain LR, KuLSIF, Boost, and the SO/TB reference columns, with the same 11 domain-adaptation methods. Deep-Coral becoming DCoral in the prose is a naming change, not a new comparator.

E3.justification: For Experiment (b) in Section 6.1, v1 says the regression solution was computed analytically; v2 says BFGS optimized the representer-theorem weights. This revises the reported procedure without establishing a rerun. The benchmark splits, budgets, metrics, and regularization settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The sample-size and regularization illustration in Figure 2 and the importance-weighted regression case study in Figure 3 are retained. No additional ablation, robustness test, or supplementary empirical analysis appears.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over three random initializations, and Appendix C specifies three seeds/runs. No uncertainty-estimation practice or statistical test is added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–34 match, and the synthetic error values are retained. However, Section 6.3 removes the finding that EW always has the highest average accuracy. Both versions' Table 1 shows MiniDomainNet IWV means of 0.514 for KuLSIF versus 0.513 for EW.

T1.justification: Theorem 1 and Corollary 1 retain their statements. Appendix B extracts and revises the affinity argument from v1's Lemma 4 into v2's Lemma 4, while the original Bayes-risk statement becomes Lemma 5. Revisions include restoring a constant term, explicit multivariate measure constructions with an interior-point premise, and changed intermediate algebra in B.3; the central characterization is unchanged.

C1.justification: The introduction narrows its characterization claim: v1 advertises a convex, strictly proper composite loss for a given g; v2 explicitly requires increasing g and separates the general characterization from the convexity consequence. The principal loss-design and application contributions remain the same.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the explanations about flatter estimates, improved target error at the expense of source error, lack of self-concordance except for the stated special case, and unresolved sample complexity. No substantive new limitation or mechanism interpretation is added.

D1.justification: Section 6.2 removes v1's direct LargeDRE implementation link and adds links to the upstream Gruber framework, IWA, and AdaTime. This changes code-access guidance; Appendix C's model, split, hyperparameter, and training-count disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V2 adds Gneiting and Raftery (2007), Nikzad-Langerodi et al. (2019), and Zellinger et al. (2019), and removes Ceylan and Gutmann (2018) and Grover and Ermon (2018). It also makes the dependence on Reid and Williamson and Menon and Ong more explicit. Nguyen's report-to-publication update represents the same work.

P1.justification: V2 rewrites the abstract, adds a contribution summary and appendix contents, separates the novelty remarks, reorders the loss examples, and updates affiliation and acknowledgments. These are targeted revisions within the retained main-section and appendix organization.

P2.justification: The entire document adopts the ICLR layout, changing typography, headings, running headers, margins, paper dimensions, and figure/table placement. Figure 1 is recolored and its caption explicitly includes both tails. The same three figures and 34 result tables are retained rather than expanded.

improvement.justification: V2 clarifies contribution scope and removes an accuracy claim contradicted by Table 1. However, the revised Appendix B.1 proof evaluates zeta and its derivative at 1 without establishing finite endpoint values, and assumes an interior point of X beyond the stated compactness assumption. These unresolved proof issues and removal of the direct implementation link offset the clearer exposition; the unchanged empirical evidence does not resolve the net quality tradeoff.
